entities.summary: Tibetan civilization — built around Vajrayana Buddhism, the Dalai Lama institution, and high-altitude adaptation — faced existential threat after China's 1950 annexation. The Tibetan diaspora, led by the 14th Dalai Lama, became a global symbol of nonviolent resistance.
